name: CLAWDdcaV3

fields.name: owner
fields.description: Position owner — only this address can withdraw or close

fields.name: targetToken
fields.description: ERC-20 the user is DCA'ing into

fields.name: tokenAccrued
fields.description: Target token bought so far, awaiting withdraw

fields.name: slippageBps
fields.description: Slippage tolerance applied to QuoterV2 output

fields.name: active
fields.description: False when usdcBalance == 0 or closePosition was called

params.name: keeperFee
params.description: USDC paid to keeper (10 bps of amountSwapped)

params.name: usdcIn
params.description: USDC routed through the burn swap

notes: Keeper fee is paid in USDC to msg.sender immediately on execute. Other fees accrue on-contract.
Burn fee always converts USDC→CLAWD via burnSwapPath (owner-configurable), regardless of position target.
executeBatch wraps each position in try/catch — a single failing position does not revert the batch.
createPositionViaWETH auto-builds the path; createPosition accepts a raw Uniswap V3 path for advanced flows.
Position IDs start at 0 and increment via nextPositionId++.

executeDCAWithMin is the sandwich-resistant path — callers pass a min-out computed off-chain. executeDCA falls back to QuoterV2 + slippage in-tx (not sandwich-safe; tolerates quoter failures with minOut=1).
closePosition is callable by the position owner OR the contract owner (emergency wind-down).
renounceOwnership is permanently disabled to prevent the contract from being orphaned.
